name: dev-companion-assistant
description: All-in-one developer companion: Context-aware greetings, motivational thoughts, dev humor, plus scheduled water, coffee, lunch, and posture wellness reminders.
author: Avinash Shinde

smartGreeting.enabled.description: Enable or disable DevCompanion notifications and greetings.

smartGreeting.name.description: Your name for personalized greetings (e.g. Avi). Falls back to 'Developer' if empty.

smartGreeting.workingHoursStart.description: Work day start time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

smartGreeting.workingHoursEnd.description: Work day end time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

smartGreeting.frequency.description: How often startup greetings should appear.

smartGreeting.showOnStartup.description: Display greeting dashboard when VS Code launches.

smartGreeting.lateNightMessages.description: Display friendly, encouraging messages late at night.

smartGreeting.weekendMessages.description: Display special messages on Saturdays and Sundays.

smartGreeting.displayStyle.description: Choose between modern Fluent dashboard popup, standard toast notification, or both.

smartGreeting.autoCloseSeconds.description: Duration in seconds before the popup automatically closes. Set to 0 to keep it open until manually dismissed.

smartGreeting.showMotivation.description: Show randomized daily motivational quotes and reflections in the dashboard.

smartGreeting.showMemes.description: Show randomized developer memes, programming jokes, and comedic relief in the dashboard.

smartGreeting.waterReminder.description: Enable scheduled hydration and water break reminders while coding.

smartGreeting.waterIntervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between hydration / water drink reminders.

smartGreeting.waterDailyGoal.description: Daily target number of water glasses (250ml each).

smartGreeting.coffeeReminder.description: Enable scheduled coffee and tea break reminders.

smartGreeting.coffeeIntervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between coffee/tea pause reminders.

smartGreeting.lunchTime.description: Time of day for lunch break alert in 24-hour HH:mm format.

smartGreeting.postureReminder.description: Enable periodic ergonomic posture and 20-20-20 eye stretch reminders.

smartGreeting.postureIntervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between posture checks and eye rest reminders.
